forbidden_lemma_policy.required: All manual proofs and added case_lib helper proofs must avoid every listed forbidden lemma and pass the downstream name scan.

mandatory_direct_routes.route: Normalize the list equality, unfold xizi_sll_head in the first disjunct, expose its first pointer, then sep_apply xizi_sll_head_split_target directly in each disjunct; finish with Intros/Exists/entailer. Do not insert derivable1_trans or any logic-equivalence bridge.

Use the suffixed first-hit decomposition helper to instantiate l1/l2, introduce the strong-post wand, rewrite xizi_sll_remove_first to prefix ++ suffix, and sep_apply the suffixed node-field-to-node helper to the exact detached field resource. Do not use derivable1_sepcon_mono.

natural_language_analysis.summary: All eight current P |-- Q obligations close from existing list-shape resources and pure equalities. No postcondition requests an absent ownership resource. The only new mathematical fact worth factoring is the first-hit decomposition of xizi_sll_remove_first; a second small spatial helper packages conversion of the detached node_next field into xizi_sll_node. Both are group-local, proved, and suffixed.

group_plan.grouping_rationale: Two groups minimize worker count while separating the genuinely different operational list-state proofs from higher-order named-spec/magic-wand derivations. Group sizes 5 and 3 are below the controller maximum of 12.

proof_groups.proof_strategy: Prove sequentially using xizi_sll_to_target_not_same/same/zero_nonzero, xizi_sllseg_len1, xizi_sllseg_sllseg, xizi_sllseg_sll, xizi_sll_head_from_cons, and xizi_sll_head_split_target. Normalize lists and pointer equalities before direct sep_apply. For which_implies, unfold the folded head branch and sep_apply xizi_sll_head_split_target directly in both disjuncts. Never use derivable1_trans or any name from forbidden_lemma.md.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: One linked-list traversal proof family; keeping the initialization, loop transition, impossible exit, and return reconstruction together lets one worker reuse exact predicate unfoldings.
